title: Tech support refund, wire back the 'overpayment'

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is the refund desk at your antivirus provider. We refunded you four hundred for the cancelled plan but our technician accidentally sent nine thousand four hundred into your account.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I do see a larger balance than I expected.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That was our error and the technician will be dismissed unless it is corrected today. Please wire the nine thousand difference to our settlements account before close of business.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I would not want anyone fired over a typo.

review_note: Refund overpayment scam. New payee on WIRE and over 3x baseline, so facts alone hold. The 'larger balance' is a manipulated screen or a transfer between her own accounts.
